-- Check pay history for employees in these departments
SELECT 
    edh.businessentityid,
    eph.rate,
    eph.ratechangedate
FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh
INNER JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
INNER JOIN humanresources.employeepayhistory eph ON edh.businessentityid = eph.businessentityid
WHERE d.name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
  AND edh.enddate IS NULL
ORDER BY edh.businessentityid, eph.ratechangedate DESC;
